title: Solid and beautiful
detail: Heavier and better made than expected. The oil finish is lovely.

title: Good, delivery slow
detail: Great piece, but it took six weeks. Worth the wait, just plan ahead.

title: Room of choice delivery
detail: Two people carried it upstairs and took the packaging. Excellent.

title: Cover replaced for free
detail: A stain that would not come out. New cover, no charge.

title: Linen softens fast
detail: Crisp on day one, soft after three washes. Sleeping better.

title: Colour is true
detail: The oatmeal is the oatmeal in the photo. No surprises.

title: Wobbles a little
detail: One leg needed a shim on my old floor. Fine after that.

title: Guests ask where it is from
detail: Every time. The answer is always this shop.

title: Candle burns even
detail: No tunnelling, no soot, forty hours as promised.

title: Too firm for me
detail: Well made sofa, but the seat is firmer than the showroom feel I wanted.

title: Assembled in ten minutes
detail: Four bolts and a key. Instructions with actual words.

title: Mug keeps coffee hot
detail: Thick stoneware. My coffee stays warm through a whole call.

title: Rug sheds at first
detail: Wool fluff for two weeks, then it settled. Vacuum often at first.

title: Fits the alcove exactly
detail: I measured twice and it fits to the centimetre.

title: Throw is generous
detail: Big enough for two on the sofa. Fringe has not shed.

title: Paint chipped on the edge
detail: Small chip on the frame from transit. Touch-up pot sent free.

title: Table takes a beating
detail: Kids, homework, dinner. The oak just gets better.

title: Lamp gives a warm pool
detail: Perfect reading light. The switch on the cord is handy.

title: Smells of wood
detail: Opened the box and the workshop came with it.

title: Cushion lost its shape
detail: Feather filling flattens. Plump it daily or choose foam.

title: Vase is heavy
detail: Stoneware with real weight. Tulips do not tip it.

title: Worth the wait
detail: Eight weeks, made to order, and it shows in every joint.

title: Storage inside the bench
detail: I did not notice the lid lifts. Winter blankets live there now.

title: Sheets fit a deep mattress
detail: Finally a fitted sheet that stays on the corners.
